abasin.notes: We are open for the 2026/27 Season!As A-Basin celebrates its 80th anniversary this winter, the ski area will mark the occasionwith a season-long celebration of the people and culture that have shaped The Legend forgenerations. While much has changed over eight decades, the spirit of A-Basin remains thesame.All season long, join us in celebrating nearly a century of fantastic skiing and riding withevents, deals, giveaways, and more.80-Year-Olds Ski Free – You’ve been with us this whole time. So, in celebration of A-Basin'slegacy and yours, anyone who is 80 years old can ski free every Wednesday

copper.notes: New snow overnight! 1 inch in the last 12 hours with a little more to fall in the early AM. Temps will be in the mid-20s with 5-10 mph winds from the west. Be sure to check out the whole mountain as the American Flyer is open along with the American Eagle and Easy Rider!Keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram for opening alerts. Our crews are out there now hard at work filling our trails with snow. A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space.Hope

eldora.notes: 5:03 AM update –Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Tuesday, November 24, 2026.HAPPY OPENING DAY!We are officially open for alpine skiing and riding. We couldn’t be more excited to welcome you, our devoted community members, back for another great season at your backyard mountain. We are so proud of our incredibly hardworking employees, whose relentless efforts have allowed us to open today, the Tuesday before Thanksgiving. They deserve a HUGE round of applause.Terrain:We'll have 1,000 vertical feet of downhill riding and skiing on Hornblower and Internationa
